title: Cabbage Dragon and Red Women
description: A large green dragon curled inside a giant cabbage holds a lit candle in its mouth while four women in flowing red dresses with dark hair perform ritualistic gestures around it, some with sparks emanating from their hands. To the right, another woman in a red dress sits on a blue chaise lounge by an arched window overlooking a frozen sea with floating candles at dusk.
